disclaimer: Category model for data Kingsfield will offer. Inspired by public product surfaces of Trellis, Lex Machina, Wolfram Demonstrations, Pre/Dicta, and Premonition. Not a scrape or affiliate of those vendors. Not legal advice. Predictive fields are forecasts, not holdings.

top.name: State Trial Court Intelligence
top.blurb: Judge-level intelligence mined from raw state trial-court dockets: biography, docket mix, motions, dispositions, and milestone clocks.

top.name: Enterprise and Federal Court Analytics
top.blurb: Structured federal and select-state analytics: motion metrics, timing models, legal findings, appeals, class actions, and entity histories.

top.name: Computational and Predictive Modeling
top.blurb: Mathematical and predictive layers: decision-tree judge approximations, precedent graphs, settlement zones, panel voting models, and counsel/forum forecasts.

main.name: Subjective and Professional History
main.blurb: Who the judge is on paper: career path, schools, affiliations, and how to reach chambers.

main.name: High-Level Metrics
main.blurb: Current docket load, case length, bench-verdict mix, and practice-area composition.

main.name: Granular Motion Practice
main.blurb: Grant, deny, and partial-grant rates by motion type, with county and state comparators.

main.name: Case Dispositions
main.blurb: How matters actually end: dismissal, settlement, verdict, consolidation, removal, class-action money, mapped holdings.

main.name: Timing Analytics
main.blurb: Clocks from filing to first dismissal, trial, and final disposition, plus forecasted milestone dates.

main.name: Outcome and Performance Forecasting
main.blurb: Forward-looking scores: early-motion odds, forum and counsel selection, settlement bands, panel math, precedent distance.

factual.name: Career and Employment History
factual.sentence: Tracks the judge’s prior legal roles and practice environments (prosecutor, defender, firm, bench) as a path, not a slogan.

jev.note: Structured facts; do not ask Jev to invent a bio.

factual.name: Educational Background
factual.sentence: Identifies law school, undergraduate, and clerkship ties that often predict local procedural culture.

factual.name: Professional and Political Affiliations
factual.sentence: Lists bar sections, Inns of Court, policy groups, and partisan offices the judge has publicly associated with.

jev.note: Public-record affiliations only; no inferred ideology score as a fact.

factual.name: Practical Chambers Data
factual.sentence: Publishes clerk phone, department, standing orders, and courtroom rules a filer actually needs.

factual.name: Active Cases
factual.sentence: Counts matters currently pending on the judge’s docket at the snapshot date.

factual.name: Average Case Length
factual.sentence: Reports the typical time a case sits before this judge from filing to close.

factual.name: Verdict Breakdown
factual.sentence: Shows the statistical mix of bench-trial outcomes (plaintiff, defense, mixed, directed) for this judge.

factual.name: Case Practice Area Breakdown
factual.sentence: Splits the docket by broad practice area such as torts, commercial, property, or labor and employment.

factual.name: Matter Type Breakdown
factual.sentence: Splits the same docket into granular matter types such as eminent domain or wrongful termination.

factual.name: Motion-by-Motion Success Rates
factual.sentence: Gives grant, denial, and partial-grant rates across 40-plus motion types (demurrer, summary judgment, in limine, and the rest).

factual.name: Comparative Motion Benchmarks
factual.sentence: Sets the judge’s motion rates next to county and state averages so outliers are visible.

factual.name: Disposition Breakdown
factual.sentence: Tracks how this judge’s cases end: dismissal, settlement, jury verdict, consolidation, or removal.

factual.name: Average Case Duration
factual.sentence: Average days from filing to disposition, ignoring how the case ended.

factual.name: Average Time to Trial
factual.sentence: Average days from filing to the first day of trial before this judge.

factual.name: Average Time to First Dismissal Order
factual.sentence: Average days to the first dismissal order, used as a rough statistical proxy for settlement timing.

jev.note: Proxy only; dismissal is not settlement.

factual.name: State Court Motion Metrics
factual.sentence: Document-driven motion-practice and timing stats for 40-plus motion types on state dockets, keyed by judge.

factual.name: Timing Events
factual.sentence: Algorithmic forecasts of when a matter is likely to hit key litigation milestones in this forum.

jev.note: Keep the model in stats code; Jev can only gate whether a forecast is in-family.

factual.name: Legal Findings
factual.sentence: Practice-specific holdings mapped onto the judgment events that produced them.

factual.name: Appeals Analytics
factual.sentence: Reversal rates, rehearing outcomes, and Supreme Court history for this judge’s or this court’s appellate trail.

factual.name: Class Action Analytics
factual.sentence: Summarizes settlement dollars, fee awards, and class-representative awards to bound a litigation budget.

factual.name: Entity Profiling
factual.sentence: Comparative case histories for opposing counsel, firms, parties, experts, and courts against this judge.

factual.name: Approximating a Judge
factual.sentence: Fits binary decision trees and if-then rules that approximate the splits this judge appears to apply to stated facts.

factual.name: Synthetic Legal Precedent Structures
factual.sentence: Builds layered citation graphs from feature distance and Lévy-flight-style jumps among like-featured prior cases.

factual.name: The Duty to Settle
factual.sentence: Computes a reasonable settlement zone from policy limits, coverage probability, costs, and attachable assets.

jev.note: Arithmetic lives in code; Jev does not invent numbers.

factual.name: Jury and Voting Models
factual.sentence: Runs panel-probability math (Condorcet jury theorem, Banzhaf index) for multi-member courts and juries.

factual.name: Judicial Outcome Prediction
factual.sentence: Estimates odds of early rulings such as motions to dismiss and summary judgment; vendor-claimed accuracy is not Kingsfield’s claim.

factual.name: Litigation Timelines
factual.sentence: Projects duration bands for pre-discovery, discovery, and trial phases in this forum before this judge.

factual.name: Forum and Strategy Optimization
factual.sentence: Surfaces data on motion timing, forum choice, and expert selection given comparable past matters.

factual.name: Counsel-Performance Analytics
factual.sentence: Benchmarks how named attorneys fare, how long they take, and how they finish in front of this specific judge.

jev.note: Selection aid only; never a competence smear presented as fact.
